name: io.github.noahowsh/fighterapi
title: FighterAPI
description: UFC fights since 2000, plus PFL and Bellator: results, round stats, fighters and odds. REST and MCP.

headers.name: x-api-key
headers.description: Your FighterAPI API key. Get a free key with 500 credits at fighterapi.com/signup

tools.name: list_events
tools.description: Cards by year and status, with the main event

tools.name: search_fighters
tools.description: Find fighters by name or nickname

tools.name: get_event
tools.description: A card's fights with results, method, round, time and judges' scores

tools.name: get_schedule
tools.description: Upcoming fights with current moneylines where a book has posted one

tools.name: get_ratings
tools.description: Our fighter ratings (Elo from every UFC result since 2000)

tools.name: get_fight
tools.description: One fight: result, full stat sheets, round-by-round lines, ratings and odds

tools.name: get_fighter
tools.description: Profile, UFC record by method, career rates, rating and recent fights

tools.name: get_fighter_fights
tools.description: A fighter's full UFC history with stats, ratings and closing lines

tools.name: get_leaders
tools.description: Career leaderboards from every fight's stat sheet

tools.name: get_odds
tools.description: Opening, closing and current moneylines by sportsbook for a fight (5) or a card (10)

tools.name: get_line_movement
tools.description: Snapshots of each posted line before a fight
